run_generate_level0_puzzles: run generate_level0_puzzles to create a directory of solvable PushWorld puzzles with default constraints
create_puzzle_generate_puzzle: create a single PushWorld puzzle grid with specified width, height, walls, obstacles, and goal objects
test_filter_puzzles_by_solvability: test filter_puzzles_by_solvability to remove unsolvable puzzles using the RGD planner with a time limit
review_failed_to_generate_error: review the FailedToGenerateError exception class raised when puzzle generation cannot complete
build_place_object: build puzzle layouts by placing objects with given symbols and shapes into a grid at random valid positions
